WITH per_txn AS (
  SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) as txn_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE anlycount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY transref
),
overall_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(txn_avg) as overall_avg
  FROM per_txn
),
kept_txns AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.txn_avg
  FROM per_txn p, overall_avg_val o
  WHERE p.txn_avg > o.overall_avg
),
kept_avg_val AS (
  SELECT AVG(txn_avg) as kept_avg
  FROM kept_txns
)
SELECT 
  k.transref,
  k.txn_avg,
  k.txn_avg - oav.overall_avg as above_overall,
  k.txn_avg - kav.kept_avg as above_kept
FROM kept_txns k
CROSS JOIN kept_avg_val kav
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_val oav
ORDER BY above_kept DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Grouping by unique transref values and computing per-transaction average (AVG of all non-NULL anlycount values for that transref), not analyzing each row separately.
'Above the overall average' means strictly greater than (>), not greater-than-or-equal (>=).
